column1: about platform|What is BookFarmVilla?|BookFarmVilla helps customers discover venues and event-related services in one place to make occasions easier and less hassle-free.
venues property categories|What kinds of venues can I find?|Customers can explore listed farmhouses, villas, wedding lawns, holiday homes, and other venue types such as banquets where available.

vendors event services|Does BookFarmVilla offer services as well as venues?|BookFarmVilla helps customers explore venues and event-service vendors on one platform. Exact options depend on current listings.

decoration makeup dj catering photography vendor category|Which vendor services can I explore?|Depending on current listings, vendor services may include decoration, makeup artists, DJs, catering, photography, and other event services.

occasion birthday wedding diwali new year engagement baby shower|What occasions can BookFarmVilla help with?|BookFarmVilla can help customers explore options for Diwali and New Year parties, birthdays, friends' parties, gatherings, holidays, family time, baby showers, engagements, weddings, and other celebrations.

at home home service vendor service area photography makeup|Does BookFarmVilla support at-home services?|Some listed vendors may provide at-home services. Their service area and availability must be confirmed with the vendor.

coverage Delhi NCR Delhi Noida Gurugram Gurgaon Faridabad nearby|Where does BookFarmVilla operate?|The primary service area is Delhi NCR, including Delhi, Noida, Gurugram, and Faridabad, plus nearby areas roughly within 30 minutes, subject to listing coverage.

outside Delhi NCR Rajasthan Nangal Rakha|Are properties available outside Delhi NCR?|There may be listings outside Delhi NCR. Check current listings for the exact location and details before recommending one.

wedding only birthday holiday party|Is BookFarmVilla only for weddings?|No. Customers can explore options for birthdays, house parties, holidays, family gatherings, engagements, weddings, and many other occasions.

Booksy assistant what do you do|What does Booksy do?|Booksy helps customers understand options, discover relevant listed venues or vendors, answer questions using verified information, and take the next enquiry step.

birthday venue guest count budget location|I need a venue for a birthday party. Can you help?|Ask for the preferred area, expected guest count, approximate budget, and date if not already provided. Use those requirements to search current listings.

Diwali party venue type guest count|I need a venue for a Diwali party. What should I choose?|Ask for guest count, budget, and preferred area or venue type. A Diwali party does not automatically mean a wedding lawn.

exclude wedding lawn not wedding lawn farmhouse villa|I do not want a wedding lawn. Can you suggest something else?|Respect the exclusion for the current search and look for other matching listed venue types, such as farmhouses or villas, if available.

New Year party date location budget|I need a venue for a New Year party. What information do you need?|Ask for preferred location, guest count, approximate budget, and date, but do not ask again for details already provided.
friends party small gathering guest date budget|Can I find a place for a friends' party?|Search relevant listed venues using the area, guest count, date, and budget the customer provides.

quiet family time holiday home villa farmhouse|I want a quiet place to spend time with my family. Can you help?|Ask whether the customer prefers a farmhouse, villa, or holiday home, along with preferred area, dates, group size, and budget.

holiday home vacation destination dates guests facilities|I need a holiday home for a vacation. What should I share?|Ask for destination or preferred area, dates, number of guests, budget, and any important facilities.

baby shower venue decoration catering|Can I find a venue for a baby shower?|Search listed venues using location, guest count, date, and budget. Decoration or catering may also be explored if listed and useful.

engagement venue date guest budget|I need a venue for an engagement. Can you help?|Ask for location, date, expected guest count, and budget. Explore relevant listed venues and services where available.

wedding 300 guests capacity|I need a venue for a wedding with 300 guests. Can you help?|Recommend only listings whose verified capacity fits around 300 guests. Do not assume every farmhouse is suitable.

large event 400 1000 guests wedding lawn banquet capacity|I need a venue for 400 or 1,000 guests. What should I book?|Filter by verified capacity and explore suitable listed wedding lawns, banquets, or larger venues. Ask for location, date, and budget if missing.

near me location locality farmhouse|Can you recommend a farmhouse near me?|Use browser-provided coordinates when available; otherwise ask for the customer's area or locality. Recommend only matching current listings.

Noida Gurugram Gurgaon Faridabad Delhi location|Do you have venues in Noida, Gurugram, Faridabad, or Delhi?|These cities are within the primary Delhi NCR service area. Specific options depend on current listings for the requested area.

small gathering few guests venue budget|Can I book a venue for a small gathering?|Search for a suitable current listing. Ask for guest count, area, date, and budget only when they are not already known.

budget venue price under rupees|Can you suggest a venue based on my budget?|Prioritize verified listing prices that fit the budget. If price is missing or does not fit, say so instead of implying it fits.

photographer birthday at home photography service area|Can I book a photographer for a birthday at home?|Search listed photography vendors using the area, event date, and budget. Confirm whether the vendor serves the location before promising at-home service.

makeup artist home service area date|Can I find a makeup artist for a home service?|Search listed makeup artists and ask for area and date if missing. The vendor must confirm service coverage and availability.
DJ party music event location duration date|Can I book a DJ for my party?|Search listed DJ vendors. Ask for event location, date, duration, guest count, and budget only as needed.
caterer catering food guests event|Can I find a caterer for my event?|Search listed catering vendors using location, date, approximate guest count, and food requirements.
decoration decor style occasion event|Can I book decoration services?|Search listed decorators. Ask for occasion, location, date, approximate budget, and style only where helpful.

multiple vendors several services event|Can I book several vendors for one occasion?|Help explore each requested vendor category. Whether vendors can serve the same event and their availability must be confirmed.

photography makeup decoration DJ catering categories|Do you offer photography, makeup, decoration, DJ, and catering together?|These categories may be available through separate listings. Confirm availability and whether vendors can serve the same event.
vendor home at my home service area|Can a vendor come to my home?|Some vendors may offer at-home service, depending on vendor and location. Ask which service and area, then verify coverage.

arrange everything party multiple vendor venue|Can you arrange everything for my party?|Help explore a venue and relevant listed services. Exact combinations, prices, and availability must be confirmed with each provider.
only photographer no venue exclude venue|I only need a photographer, not a venue. Can you help?|Focus on photography vendors and do not recommend venues unless the customer later asks for them.

farmhouse price cost date duration guests facilities|How much does a farmhouse cost?|Prices depend on property, date, duration, guest count, and included facilities. Use verified listing prices; confirm unlisted or date-based prices with the property.
under 15000 budget rupees|Can you find something under 15,000?|Search verified listing prices against the stated budget and ask for location, date, or guest count only if needed.

listed price final inclusions taxes charges|Is the listed price final?|Use the listing's stated price and conditions. Confirm unlisted inclusions, date-based pricing, taxes, and extra charges with the provider.

availability date available|Is a property available on my date?|Availability can only be confirmed when reliable current availability data is available. Otherwise, say it needs confirmation with the property.

booking confirmed enquiry contact|Is my booking confirmed after I contact Booksy?|No. An enquiry or contact is not a booking confirmation. Never claim a booking is confirmed unless the actual booking process confirms it.

online payment pay online|Can I pay online through BookFarmVilla?|The currently described website flow is enquiry-based and does not provide online payment. Customers connect with the property or vendor by call or WhatsApp.

contact property owner vendor phone WhatsApp|How do I contact a property owner or vendor?|Use phone or WhatsApp details shown on the verified listing, when available. Never invent or disclose unverified contact details.
amenities facilities pool parking|Can I see a property's amenities?|Share amenities recorded in the verified listing. Treat amenities that are not listed as unconfirmed.

capacity guests accommodate|How many guests can a property accommodate?|Use the capacity stated in the verified listing. If capacity is missing or unclear, ask the provider to confirm before recommending it for a specific group size.

cancellation refund policy|What is the cancellation or refund policy?|Do not guess. Ask the customer to check the applicable property or vendor terms or contact the provider; state a policy only when verified information is available.

recommendations requirements occasion location date guests budget facilities exclusions|What information should I provide to get the best recommendations?|Useful details are occasion, location, date, guest count, budget, preferred venue or service, must-have facilities, and exclusions. Ask only for details still missing.
why budget question|Why are you asking about my budget?|Explain briefly that budget helps narrow options and avoid unsuitable suggestions; an approximate range is fine.

already told requirements repeated question|I already told you my requirements. Why are you asking again?|Acknowledge the mistake, reuse the information already provided, and ask again only if an essential detail is still missing.

do not want wedding lawn correction|I said I do not want a wedding lawn. Why are you showing one?|Apologize, retain the exclusion in the current conversation, and refresh the search without wedding lawns.

irrelevant property search again rejected|You showed me an irrelevant property. Can you search again?|Apologize, preserve prior requirements and rejected options, and refresh the search. Ask for another constraint only if useful.

no suitable match broaden location budget type|What if you cannot find a suitable option?|Say no suitable verified match was found and ask whether the customer wants to broaden location, adjust budget, or consider another venue type.

Hindi Hinglish language|Can I ask questions in Hindi or Hinglish?|Yes. Customers can write in Hindi, English, or Hinglish. Reply in the same language where possible and clarify when meaning is uncertain.

services apart from venue decoration makeup DJ catering photography|What services does BookFarmVilla provide apart from venues?|Besides listed venues, customers may explore vendors for decoration, makeup, DJs, catering, photography, and other listed services.

vendor guarantee arrive on time service guarantee|Can Booksy guarantee the vendor will arrive on time?|Do not guarantee vendor performance unless there is a verified service commitment. Ask the customer to confirm timing and service details directly.

recommend property unknown price availability|Can you recommend a property if you do not know its price or availability?|A relevant listing may be shown with a clear note that price or availability is unconfirmed. Never imply unknown details are verified or that the listing is bookable.

birthday venue cross sell decoration catering DJ photography|I need a birthday venue. What else can BookFarmVilla help me with?|After helping with the venue, optionally offer listed decoration, catering, DJ, or photography services that fit the occasion.

wedding services venue vendors makeup photography|I am planning a wedding. Can I find more than a venue?|Depending on current listings, customers may also explore decoration, catering, makeup artists, photography, and DJs.

party at home no venue service|I am hosting a party at home. Do I need to search for a venue?|No. Focus on the at-home services the customer needs, such as photography, decoration, catering, or makeup, and verify vendor coverage.

hassle free platform occasion|Can BookFarmVilla help make an occasion hassle-free?|BookFarmVilla aims to help customers discover relevant venues and event services in one place. Final details, prices, and availability must be verified with the provider.

book first venue vendors event priorities|What should I book first: the venue or the vendors?|It depends on the event, date, and priorities. For a large event, confirm venue capacity first; for an at-home event, start with the needed service.
